question:
Study the table showing the maximum temperature (in °C) of five cities over six months and answer the question.

City | Jan | Feb | Mar | Apr | May | Jun
Delhi | 21 | 24 | 30 | 36 | 40 | 38
Mumbai | 30 | 31 | 32 | 33 | 34 | 33
Kolkata | 26 | 28 | 34 | 37 | 36 | 34
Chennai | 29 | 30 | 32 | 35 | 37 | 36
Shimla | 10 | 12 | 16 | 21 | 25 | 24

Q. Which city experienced the highest absolute range of temperature between its lowest and highest recorded values across the six months?
explanation: Ranges: Delhi = 40 - 21 = 19; Mumbai = 34 - 30 = 4; Kolkata = 37 - 26 = 11; Chennai = 37 - 29 = 8; Shimla = 25 - 10 = 15. Delhi has the highest range (19). Option Kolkata is incorrect as its range is 11.

question:
Study the table showing the number of train passengers (in thousands) by class over five years and answer the question.

Year | AC First | AC Tier-2 | AC Tier-3 | Sleeper | General
2019 | 15 | 45 | 120 | 350 | 500
2020 | 10 | 30 | 90 | 280 | 400
2021 | 12 | 35 | 110 | 310 | 450
2022 | 18 | 50 | 140 | 390 | 550
2023 | 20 | 60 | 160 | 420 | 600

Q. What is the total number of passengers across all classes in the year 2022?
explanation: Total passengers in 2022 = AC First (18) + AC Tier-2 (50) + AC Tier-3 (140) + Sleeper (390) + General (550) = 1,148 thousand. Option 1,098 thousand is incorrect.

Q. What is the ratio of total General passengers to total AC First passengers across the entire 5-year period?
explanation: Total AC Tier-2 = 45 + 30 + 35 + 50 + 60 = 220 thousand. Total AC First = 15 + 10 + 12 + 18 + 20 = 75 thousand. Ratio = 220 : 75 = 44 : 15. Option 3 : 1 is incorrect.

question:
Study the table showing the pass, fail and absent students of a school over five years and answer the question.

2019 | 420 | 60 | 20
2020 | 350 | 90 | 30
2021 | 480 | 40 | 10
2022 | 540 | 50 | 10

Q. Between which two consecutive years was the absolute increase in the number of passed students the highest?
explanation: Absolute increase in passed students: 2019 to 2020 = 350 - 420 = -70; 2020 to 2021 = 480 - 350 = 130; 2021 to 2022 = 540 - 480 = 60; 2022 to 2023 = 600 - 540 = 60. The highest increase is 130 between 2020 and 2021. Option 2021 to 2022 is incorrect.

2020 | 110 | 140
2021 | 125 | 160

Q. In which year was the combined production of Plant B and Plant C the lowest?
explanation: Combined production (Plant B + Plant C) for each year: 2019 = 95 + 150 = 245; 2020 = 110 + 140 = 250; 2021 = 125 + 160 = 285; 2022 = 140 + 175 = 315; 2023 = 160 + 190 = 350. The lowest combined production is in 2019 (245). Option A is incorrect as 2020 total is 250.

question:
Study the table below showing the percentage share of Agriculture, Industry, and Services in GDP over five years and answer the question.

Sectoral Share in GDP (%)
Year | Agriculture | Industry | Services
2019 | 18.5 | 31.5 | 50.0
2020 | 20.0 | 29.0 | 51.0
2021 | 19.0 | 30.5 | 50.5
2022 | 17.5 | 32.0 | 50.5
2023 | 16.5 | 33.5 | 50.0

Q. In which year was the share of Industry in GDP the lowest?
explanation: Looking at the Industry column across the years: 2019 = 31.5%, 2020 = 29.0%, 2021 = 30.5%, 2022 = 32.0%, 2023 = 33.5%. The lowest share is 29.0% in 2020. Option A is incorrect as Industry share in 2019 was 31.5%.

Q. If the total GDP in 2023 was ₹200 lakh crore, what was the value of the output from the Services sector in that year?
explanation: In 2023, the percentage share of Services was 50.0%. Total GDP = ₹200 lakh crore. Value of Services output = 50% of 200 = (50 / 100) * 200 = ₹100.0 lakh crore. Option B is incorrect as it miscalculates the percentage.
question_hi:

जीडीपी में क्षेत्रीय हिस्सेदारी (%)
वर्ष | कृषि | उद्योग | सेवाएं
2019 | 18.5 | 31.5 | 50.0
2020 | 20.0 | 29.0 | 51.0
2021 | 19.0 | 30.5 | 50.5

प्र. यदि 2023 में कुल जीडीपी ₹200 लाख करोड़ थी, तो उस वर्ष सेवा क्षेत्र के उत्पादन का मूल्य कितना था?
explanation_hi: 2023 में, सेवा क्षेत्र की प्रतिशत हिस्सेदारी 50.0% थी। कुल जीडीपी = ₹200 लाख करोड़। सेवा क्षेत्र के उत्पादन का मूल्य = 200 का 50% = ₹100.0 लाख करोड़। विकल्प B गलत है क्योंकि यह प्रतिशत की गलत गणना करता है।

question:
Study the table showing the monthly rainfall (in mm) in four cities across three months and answer the question.

City | June | July | August
Delhi | 120 | 210 | 180
Mumbai | 350 | 500 | 450
Kolkata | 250 | 300 | 280
Chennai | 60 | 90 | 150

Q. What is the average rainfall across all four cities for the month of July?
explanation: Rainfall in July for the four cities: Delhi (210) + Mumbai (500) + Kolkata (300) + Chennai (90) = 1100 mm. Average = 1100 / 4 = 275 mm. Option B uses an incorrect sum.
question_hi:

शहर | जून | जुलाई | अगस्त
दिल्ली | 120 | 210 | 180
मुंबई | 350 | 500 | 450
कोलकाता | 250 | 300 | 280
चेन्नई | 60 | 90 | 150

प्र. जुलाई के महीने के लिए सभी चारों शहरों की औसत वर्षा कितनी है?
explanation_hi: जुलाई में चारों शहरों की वर्षा: दिल्ली (210) + मुंबई (500) + कोलकाता (300) + चेन्नई (90) = 1100 मिमी। औसत = 1100 / 4 = 275 मिमी। विकल्प B गलत योग का उपयोग करता है।

question:
Study the table showing the number of cars sold by five companies over four years and answer the question.

Company | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Alpha | 1200 | 1500 | 1800 | 2000
Beta | 800 | 900 | 1100 | 1300
Gamma | 2000 | 1900 | 2200 | 2500
Delta | 1500 | 1600 | 1500 | 1900
Omega | 500 | 700 | 1000 | 1200

Q. Which company showed the highest absolute increase in car sales from 2020 to 2023?
explanation: Absolute increase from 2020 to 2023 for each company: Alpha = 2000 - 1200 = 800; Beta = 1300 - 800 = 500; Gamma = 2500 - 2000 = 500; Delta = 1900 - 1500 = 400; Omega = 1200 - 500 = 700. Alpha has the highest increase of 800 cars.
